summary: Schema maps cleanly onto the canonical Bank model (accounts.py, bank_transactions.py). The previously-known _CREDIT_KEYWORDS/'cr' substring bug that silently zeroed every credit-side transaction in this file is confirmed fixed: extract_canonical_bank_rows() now produces 0 rejected rows and 0 zero-amount rows, versus 227 wrongly-zeroed credit rows before the fix.
key_findings: All 5 source columns (date, description, debit, credit, balance) map to a canonical field, directly or via the debit/credit-netting transform.
No currency column present; original_currency defaults to 'NGN' for all rows (low severity, handled gracefully).

No account_number column present; account_number_hash falls back to a hash of the upload_id rather than a real account number (low severity, handled gracefully, but limits account-matching/dedup across uploads).

One row (row 158, 'LARGE TRANSFER - UNKNOWN BENEFICIARY') has both debit and credit populated at once; the ingestion code nets it via credit - abs(debit) without crashing, but it is the one row where the signed amount is not a literal read of either column (medium severity, flagged for manual check in Prompt 2).
No encoding issues found in narration text.
Credit-column keyword-collision bug (fixed prior to this run) confirmed resolved for this file: 0 zero-amount rows now vs. 227 before the fix.
